limitations: Static analysis: values computed at runtime (e.g. HTML fetched from an API then $compile()d, DB-stored templates) are invisible. $compile() is only fed templates fetched from sys/pages/*.html (podcast-manager, 3d-model-viewer, generators) or hard-coded strings in the scanned code; no server-rendered Angular HTML was found (grep of every non-public *.js).

Shared files (si-manager utilities.js, toolbox sys/js/{powerUser,colour-dots,icons,i18n,toolboxItems,aocBanners}.js) are attributed to every page that loads them, so per-page counts for those pages include shared-file sites; suite totals in the md are de-duplicated where stated.

Third-party non-Angular libs (tippy, select2, Dropzone, monaco, chart.js, tinymce, yjs bundle, pannellum, model-viewer, cash-dom...) are listed but not analysed for Angular use; none registers Angular modules (checked: only ui-grid does).
Global stylesheets served at /styles/* come from si-studydesk-styles/styles/*.css (in repo and searched); Moodle-theme CSS outside the repo cannot reach these iframes.
Template partial resolution is conservative (basename/dir-prefix match), i.e. may over-include a file used by a sibling page; this can only add false "used", never false "unused".
